proof_body:
by
  intro a b c ha
  constructor
  · intro h
    have hc : 0 < c := by simpa using h 0
    have hapos : 0 < a := by
      by_contra hn
      have hneg : a < 0 := lt_of_le_of_ne (not_lt.1 hn) ha
      have hq : 0 ≤ c / (-a) := div_nonneg hc.le (by linarith)
      have hs := Real.sq_sqrt hq
      generalize Real.sqrt (c / (-a)) = t at hs
      have h1 := h t
      have h2 := h (-t)
      have h3 : a * t ^ 2 = -c := by
        rw [hs]
        field_simp
      nlinarith
    refine ⟨hapos, ?_⟩
    have h4 := h (-b / (2 * a))
    have e : 4 * a * (a * (-b / (2 * a)) ^ 2 + b * (-b / (2 * a)) + c) = -(b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by
      field_simp
      ring
    have h5 := mul_pos (by positivity : 0 < 4 * a) h4
    linarith
  · rintro ⟨hapos, hD⟩ x
    have e : 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) = (2 * a * x + b) ^ 2 - (b ^ 2 - 4 * a * c) := by ring
    have h1 : 0 < 4 * a * (a * x ^ 2 + b * x + c) := by
      rw [e]
      nlinarith [sq_nonneg (2 * a * x + b)]
    exact (mul_pos_iff_of_pos_left (by positivity)).1 h1
